program.name: Head Start
program.description:
Head Start is a free program for children ages 3 to 5. It provides early learning, meals, health services, and support for the whole family.

Local organizations run Head Start programs in their communities. Families get services from a local program, and open spots may vary by area. Families do not pay to join.

Each local Head Start agency manages its own openings and waiting list. Some areas may have limited spots or may give certain families priority. Contact your local agency to learn what is currently available.

Select "Find your local Head Start agency" to locate a program near you. The local agency will tell you how to apply and what documents you may need.

documents.text: Child's birth certificate, hospital record, or other proof of age, if requested
Proof of identity, if requested (ex: driver's license, official state ID card)
Proof of earned income, if requested (ex: pay stubs, tax returns, W-2, 1099)
Proof of unearned income, if requested (ex: child support, Social Security, unemployment)
Proof of home address, if requested (ex: lease, utility bill)
Proof of SNAP, TANF, or SSI benefits (if applicable)
Foster care documents, if applicable (ex: court order, child welfare letter)
Homelessness verification, if applicable (ex: school or shelter letter, signed family statement)
